hero_intro: Welcome to NovaKidz! Explore letters, animals, fruits, colours and shapes through fun, colourful videos made for curious little learners.
age_note: Playful learning for little learners ages 2–4

topics.title: ABC & Letters
topics.description: Discover the alphabet, one happy letter at a time. Sing, say and learn your ABCs with us!

topics.title: Animal Friends
topics.description: Meet friendly animals, learn their names and make their wonderful sounds.

topics.title: Fruits & Veggies
topics.description: Explore yummy fruits and vegetables, their names and their bright colours.

topics.title: Colours & Shapes
topics.description: Spot beautiful colours and simple shapes all around you through playful discovery.

about_text: At NovaKidz, learning feels like play! We create bright, friendly videos that help toddlers and preschoolers discover the world through letters, animals, fruits, colours and shapes. Every little adventure is a chance to smile, explore and grow.
